description: Shared single-column, form-width-capped editing pattern for Instructor authoring screens with no exact showcase composition — Lesson Editor and Quiz Editor (Course Editor Overview/Curriculum have their own exact-showcase specs and are NOT included here, since they have a real assembled reference).

sourceReferences: design-system/COMPONENTS.md § Inputs, § File & Media Upload, § ReorderableList

structure: minimal header — screen title + Save/Cancel, no Tabs row (unlike Course Editor)
single-column stacked form fields, form-width cap
unsavedChangesGuard: navigating away with unsaved edits prompts a confirmation AppDialog — applies to both screens using this pattern (ux/NAVIGATION_SPEC.md § 6)
